3068788.variantName: Argos Home LED Christmas Interchangeable Projector
3068788.sourceDescription: There's something magical about lighting up the front of your house at Christmas - and this LED projector makes it happen without the ladder work. It projects interchangeable scenes onto your walls, switching from festive snowflakes to spooky Halloween patterns depending on what you're celebrating. You just set it up facing your home, plug it in, and let it do the work. It works indoors too, so you could create a winter grotto in the living room or add a bit of atmosphere to a party. The timer feature means you can set it and forget it, and the stand mechanism keeps it steady wherever you put it. Four LED bulbs are included, so you've got everything you need to get started straight away. . Size H 12, W 9, D 9cm.; Timer feature.; Requires 4xLED bulbs (included).; Mains powered.; Fixed using stand mechanism.; Weighs 0.6kg.; Manufacturer's 1 year guarantee.

Suitable for seasonal decorating, this durable tree can be styled with your favourite baubles, tinsel and Christmas lights. Mains-operated Christmas lights are available separately and can be used indoors or outdoors, provided the transformer remains indoors. Read the operating instructions before use. Vivo Technologies Limited, Unit 11, Rainsford Road, London, NW10 7RG

tm90d4rz.baseName: Walplus 150 LEDs Hinged Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 150 cm
tm90d4rz.variantName: Walplus 150 LEDs Hinged Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 150 cm
tm90d4rz.sourceDescription: This Modern Artificial Hinged Christmas Tree serves as a perfect addition to your festive decor, whether placed in the living room or as part of your garden festivities. Its simple, cone-shaped design offers a contemporary twist, combining minimal ornamentation with a functional approach that complements any modern interior. The adaptable nature of this tree makes it an ideal fit for both small apartments and expansive holiday settings, providing a centerpiece that captivates without overwhelming the surrounding space. High-Quality Materials Crafted from durable PVC, this tree boasts longevity and resilience, allowing it to withstand the wear of seasonal setup and storage. The PVC material gives the tree a realistic density, closely mimicking the appearance of natural fir while offering flame-resistant properties for added safety. This ensures that your decor remains both attractive and secure throughout the festive season. Effortless Lighting Equipped with LED strip lights boasting a warm white hue, the tree illuminates your space with a comforting glow. The flexible nature of these lights allows you to position them precisely, enhancing the aesthetic without the frustration of tangled wires. Designed for energy efficiency, these LEDs contribute to an economical holiday display that can brighten any room or garden. User-Friendly Assembly The tree features hinged branches that allow for straightforward assembly, requiring no additional tools besides a screwdriver for the initial setup. This design enables a hassle-free experience, letting you focus more on decoration and less on complicated processes. With clear instructions, the setup is seamless, requiring minimal effort from two people. Versatile Use Designed for both indoor and outdoor settings, this tree adapts to various holiday themes and locations. Its understated elegance allows for creative decoration —whether you're adding traditional ornaments or modern embellishments. The USB power source ensures convenient placement, without the need for proximity to a wall outlet. Care and Longevity When not in use, it is recommended to cover the tree to protect it from dust and elements, ensuring it retains its quality year after year. By following proper care instructions, you can enjoy the tree's beauty season after season without significant wear or deterioration, maintaining its novel appearance and functionality. Product Specifications Colour: Green Material: PVC and metal Tree height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 97 cm Stand size: 50 x 50 cm Durable Lifelike branch tips Reusable, Low maintenance, Simple setup, Sturdy metal stand 8 Lighting modes: combination, in wave, sequential, slow glow, chasing/running water, slow fade, twinkle/flash and steady on This luxury tree has a hinged construction, so the branches will automatically fold down in the right angle. This will make it much easier to put up the tree in the perfect shape, and will save you time as well. Number of PVC tips: 793 Number of baubles: 61 Lights type: Decorative string lights Lights color: Warm white Number of LEDs: 150 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: Plug Voltage: 5 V Wattage: 5 W Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1xArtificialChristmastree,1xStand,1xLEDstringlight,1xPeak,20x3cmball,21x4cmball,20x6cmball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

7tk664cf.variantName: Walplus 246 Branch Tips Slim Half Artificial Christmas Tree - Gold - 180 cm
7tk664cf.sourceDescription: Create a magical holiday ambiance in your home with this artificial half Christmas tree! This Xmas tree is an ideal choice if you have limited space. Lifelike material: This beautiful Christmas tree, made of PVC material, is very lifelike in its shape and appearance.Space-saving Xmas tree: This slim Christmas tree can be placed against the wall to save more space.Economical holiday decoration: The Christmas tree can be used again every year, making it a very economical choice compared to a real tree. Product Specifications Colour: Gold Material: PVC, steel Tree width: 48 cm Total height: 180 cm Stand size: 40 x 40 cm (L x W) With 246 tips Half- round Assembly required: Yes • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

nnrvx9hb.baseName: My Christmas Grey Woven Rattan Tree Skirt Cover - 60cm
nnrvx9hb.variantName: My Christmas Grey Woven Rattan Tree Skirt Cover - 60cm
nnrvx9hb.sourceDescription: This handcrafted wicker Christmas tree skirt adds rustic elegance to festive displays and complements a variety of Christmas themes. Made from eco-friendly, renewable wicker in a natural grey colour, it provides a warm and inviting finish while helping to conceal the tree stand. Suitable for living rooms, bedrooms and other decorated spaces, it can be used with both real and artificial Christmas trees and is suitable for trees up to 7 ft in height. Specifications: Handcrafted wicker design with a natural grey finish, made from eco-friendly and renewable wicker, suitable for real and artificial Christmas trees, suitable for trees up to 7 ft, designed to conceal the tree stand, and suitable for use in various indoor spaces. Dimensions: Height: 25 cm, bottom diameter: 60 cm, internal bottom diameter: 56 cm. Read the operating instructions before use. Vivo Technologies Limited, Unit 11, Rainsford Road, London, NW10 7RG
